response.original_title: Can You Add a Person to an Existing Disney Cruise Reservation? Complete Guide”
response.overview: Yes, you can add a person to an existing Disney Resort hotel or vacation package reservation as long as your room has not reached maximum capacity How to Add a Guest Online Log in to your My Disney Experience account.  1(866) 254-7549 US Go to My Plans under the My Disney Experience tab.Find your reservation and click Change Reservation or Modify Reservation. Select Change next to Travel Party and update the number of adults and children. 1(866) 254-7549 US Follow the prompts to finish. You might need to pay a price difference Alternative Ways to Modify By Phone: Call the Disney Reservation Center at 1(866) 254-7549 US for assistance.Travel Agent: If you used a travel agent or third party, you must ask them to make the change for you.
